title: Real-ESRGAN x4plus: 4x upscale
description: Upscales a source image 4x with the RealESRGAN x4plus model (ImageUpscaleWithModel), with no diffusion model and no prompt. The output is four times the source image's width and height, which the contract check compares with the task's size. LoadImage drops an alpha channel, so the output is RGB.

slots.label: Source image (file name in ComfyUI's input folder)

evidence.note: The upscale chain of the section Upscale: LoadImage, UpscaleModelLoader, ImageUpscaleWithModel (upscale_model, image), SaveImage. ComfyUI's template index has no image template for an upscale model alone (utility-gan_upscaler is a video template).
